partner.name: COCA International Singapore Co Pte Ltd
partner.description:
Originating from Bangkok, COCA Restaurant first opened its doors in Singapore in 1987 and remains known amongst Singaporean diners as an established Thai-Chinese hotpot restaurant. Take your pick from COCA’s scrumptious House Specialities such as Fish Glue, Shrimp Paste and Handmade Dumplings, along with an endless array of food offerings. Be spoilt for choice, only at COCA!

Participating Outlets:
•	Kallang Leisure Park
•	Ngee Ann City
•	Suntec City
